text: Synthesis complete (worker-4 round 4): the last 2 red tests CANNOT go green without the ehcn production decision, and here is the exact reasoning. (1) The failing leg consumes root.send_dio(source)/relay unicast targeting — a solicited UNICAST-destination DIO. (2) LICHEN's admission contract (R-09-005, Python authenticated_dio.py parity) admits ONLY canonical multicast DIOs; wire_is_for_local drops unicast-dst RPL claims pre-admission. (3) Rust receive.rs:578 (send_dio(source) after unicast DIS) is a PRODUCTION caller of the inadmissible shape; Python's UNICAST_DIO_WITH_CONFIGURATION (dis.py) exists but has ZERO production callers — so Python is already consistent with its gate, Rust is the divergent stack. (4) draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00 6.4 'Targeted DIS: unicast response' predates the gate. The contract-consistent fix is option A applied to receive.rs:578: re-target the solicited response to RPL_ALL_NODES multicast (both stacks then match), after which BOTH remaining tests pass as written (leaf hears the multicast DIO and joins). But that is a production receive-path behavior change owned by ehcn (worker-7) — flagging it as the recommended resolution with the note that RFC 6550 8.3's unicast-response SHOULD is superseded in this profile by the admission contract. My join_leaf rework (79b2b87b76) is committed and stands. Releasing 0l4q to its ehcn-linked owner; no further rpl_stack fixture work is possible without the ehcn call.
